_note: Real Gradle failure signatures. Every entry is a shape someone has actually hit, drawn from AGP/Gradle documentation and public issue trackers. Rules generated from the archive may extend this file; nothing else may.

signatures.fixture_text: Dependency {group}:{name}:{version} was not resolved. Check the coordinate is spelled correctly, the repository declaring it is in `repositories { }`, and that the version exists on Maven Central or Google's Maven repo.

signatures.match: (Unsupported class file major version|invalid target release: (\d+)|has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime \(class file version ([\d\.]+)\), this version of the Java Runtime only recognizes class file versions up to ([\d\.]+))
signatures.fixture_text: The Gradle daemon's JDK version does not match what the build declares. Set `org.gradle.java.home` in gradle.properties, or align the toolchain block in build.gradle.kts, to the required JDK.

signatures.match: The project is using an incompatible version \(AGP (\d+(?:\.\d+)*)\) of the Android Gradle plugin\. Latest supported version is AGP (\d+(?:\.\d+)*)
signatures.fixture_text: Android Gradle Plugin {current} is not compatible with this Gradle/Studio version. Bump the AGP classpath to {latest} in the top-level build.gradle (or plugins block).

signatures.match: SDK location not found\. Define a valid SDK location with an ANDROID_HOME environment variable or by setting the sdk\.dir path
signatures.fixture_text: The Android SDK path is not configured. Create a local.properties file at the project root with `sdk.dir=/absolute/path/to/Android/Sdk`, or export ANDROID_HOME in your shell.

signatures.match: Duplicate class ([^\s]+) found in modules ([^\s]+) and ([^\s]+)
signatures.fixture_text: Class {cls} is provided by two modules ({moduleA} and {moduleB}). Exclude one in the losing module's dependency block, e.g. `implementation("...") { exclude(group = "...", module = "...") }`.
R8/ProGuard is stripping {cls} that is still referenced at runtime. Add `-keep class {cls} { *; }` to proguard-rules.pro, or add the missing dependency that provides it.

signatures.match: requires (?:libraries and applications that depend on it )?to compile against version (\d+) or later of the Android APIs
signatures.fixture_text: A dependency requires compileSdk {required} or higher. Set `android { compileSdk = {required} }` in the module's build.gradle(.kts).

signatures.match: Namespace not specified\. Specify a namespace in the module's build file
signatures.fixture_text: AGP 7.3+ requires an explicit namespace. Add `android { namespace = "com.your.package" }` to the module's build.gradle(.kts), matching the application id or manifest package.

signatures.match: Could not install Gradle distribution from '([^']+)'
signatures.fixture_text: The wrapper cannot download the declared Gradle distribution ({url}). Check network access, or run `gradle wrapper --gradle-version=<installed-version>` from a machine that has Gradle installed to regenerate gradle-wrapper.properties.

signatures.match: Runtime JAR files in the classpath should have the same version\. These files were found in the classpath:[\s\S]*?kotlin-stdlib-([\d\.]+)\.jar[\s\S]*?kotlin-stdlib-([\d\.]+)\.jar
signatures.fixture_text: Two kotlin-stdlib versions on the classpath ({v1} and {v2}). Force-resolve to one: `configurations.all { resolutionStrategy.force("org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib:{v_latest}") }`.
